items.description: The swatches as data: color strings, or items whose `color` or `value` is a valid CSS color string. Each item needs a distinct color, because options are keyed by color, and duplicate colors throw a TypeError. An item's `label` or `textValue` names its swatch; otherwise the swatch uses its color name.

value.description: The selected color, when the caller controls it. `null` is controlled and empty; `undefined` leaves the value uncontrolled.

defaultValue.description: The color selected at first, when the picker controls itself.

disabled.description: Disables the picker and every swatch. A disabled enclosing ColorPicker disables it too.

readOnly.description: Makes the picker read-only: arrow keys still move focus between swatches, but presses, Space, and Enter do not select one. A read-only enclosing ColorPicker does the same.

change.description: Called with the selected swatch's color as a CSS string in that swatch's color space: rgba(r, g, b, a) for a hex or RGB swatch, and hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for an HSL or HSB swatch. A disabled or read-only picker does not call it.

members.name: value
members.description: Consumer data; named Select and ComboBox forms submit the item `id`, not `value`.

MuxUICollectionItem.description: An item a collection renders from data. Other string-keyed fields are consumer data.

MuxUIColorValue.description: A CSS color string. A color control's onChange returns one in the color space of its value, of an enclosing ColorPicker's color, or of its defaultValue: rgba(r, g, b, a) for hex and rgb, hsla(h, s%, l%, a) for hsl and hsb. ColorSlider with colorSpace uses that space, and ColorSwatchPicker returns the chosen item's color.
